title: Wrongful Tax Demand Resolved and Refund Issued
body: An employee of a public sector company received a tax demand notice of ₹1,77,740 for the financial year 2013–14, despite being eligible for relief under Section 89(1) due to arrears paid by the employer. Despite submitting all relevant documents to the Income Tax authorities multiple times, the issue remained unresolved. Seeking resolution, the individual filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Within 13 days of filing, the matter was reviewed, the erroneous demand was rectified, and a refund of ₹33,770 was successfully issued.

title: High-Value Income Tax Refund Credited After Prolonged Delay
body: A company had its Income Tax Return for Assessment Year 2022–23 processed, with a refund of ₹95,99,820 duly determined. However, despite the completion of processing, the refund was not credited to the designated bank account. After several months of follow-up with the tax authorities yielded no result, the company filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. The submission expedited the resolution process, and within three months, the full refund amount of ₹95,99,820 was successfully credited to the company’s prevalidated bank account.

title: Refund Credited After Rectification of Missed Tax Credits
body: A taxpayer faced a delay in receiving a refund amounting to ₹83,080 for Assessment Years 2021–22 and 2022–23 due to missed credits for advance tax and TDS in the filed Income Tax Returns. After repeated attempts to resolve the issue, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS portal. The matter was taken up by the concerned authorities, and a rectification order was issued crediting an advance tax payment of ₹65,000 and TDS of ₹54,272. With adjustments for regular tax and SAT, a final refund of ₹73,122 was determined and successfully credited to the taxpayer’s account in April 2024, closing the grievance.

title: TDS Mismatch Corrected and Large Refund Released
body: A taxpayer experienced significant financial distress when a mismatch between the TDS declared in the Income Tax Return for AY 2018–19 and the details reflected in Form 26AS led to an erroneous tax demand. Despite having paid all taxes and filing multiple rectification requests, the issue remained unresolved, and subsequent refunds for AYs 2021–22 and 2022–23 was wrongly adjusted against this incorrect demand. Seeking resolution, a grievance was filed on the CPGRAMS Portal. The matter was taken up by the concerned authorities, who uploaded a manual correction order. CPC processed the revised assessment and a refund of ₹37,80,761 was credited to the taxpayer’s prevalidated and nominated bank account, bringing the grievance to a close.

title: Tax Credit Discrepancy Resolved and Refund Issued
body: A taxpayer noticed a mismatch in the tax credit reflected in the assessment order for AY 2017–18, where a legitimate tax payment was not considered, despite being clearly available in Form 26AS. This error resulted in an incorrect outstanding demand being raised. After unsuccessful follow-ups, a grievance was submitted on the CPGRAMS Portal to seek redressal. Following the grievance, the authorities reviewed the case, uploaded a manual correction order, and determined a refund of ₹89,092, which was duly credited to the taxpayer’s bank account. The issue was successfully resolved.

title: Refund Issued After Delay in Electric Scooter Booking Cancellation
body: A consumer who had mistakenly paid ₹1,16,180 while booking an Ola Electric Scooter faced difficulty in securing a refund, even after receiving confirmation of a successful cancellation and refund initiation. With no refund credited despite repeated follow-ups, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS Portal with the Department of Consumer Affairs. Following this, the matter was promptly reviewed, and the refund was successfully processed within just four days of filing the grievance, bringing the issue to a close.

title: Counterfeit Plywood Scam Busted After Grievance Escalation
body: A citizen who hired an interior design firm discovered that substandard and counterfeit ISI- marked materials were used instead of the agreed Wigwam brand BWP and MR grade plywood. Despite paying ₹6,78,000 through bank transfer, the individual did not receive a GST invoice. Faced with inaction, a grievance was filed on the CPGRAMS Portal, seeking both a refund and regulatory intervention. The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) investigated the matter and conducted a raid, seizing 310 fake plywood sheets. Legal proceedings were subsequently initiated against the firm for fraudulent practices, ensuring consumer protection and accountability.
department: Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs

title: Pay Fixation and Allowance Grievance Resolved with Arrears Disbursal
body: A citizen had been seeking resolution regarding the fixation of pay and the applicable Transport Allowance (TPT) and House Rent Allowance (HRA), but his concerns remained unaddressed through regular administrative channels. Subsequently, he lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. Upon examination, it was confirmed that his pay had been revised and fixed at ₹32,900 following his promotion. Arrears were processed accordingly, including ₹9,500 as Basic Pay and ₹5,053 as Dearness Allowance. The necessary adjustments related to TPT and HRA were also completed. The disbursal of the revised pay and allowances was scheduled for the upcoming salary cycle. The citizen expressed satisfaction with the resolution of his grievance.

title: Disability Pension Restored and Arrears Credited
body: A retired Naib Subedar faced disruption in his Disability Pension after migrating to the SPARSH system in August 2023, with payments ceasing from September 2023 onward. Despite entitlement, no pension was credited for eight months, and arrears amounting to over ₹1.29 lakh remained unpaid. Seeking resolution, he filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following the intervention, the issue was resolved and a total arrear amount of ₹1,78,148 was credited to his bank account on 8 August 2024. He was advised to verify the credit by updating his bank passbook.

title: Incorrect Date of Birth in PPO Corrected After Two-Year Delay
body: A family pensioner, the wife of a deceased ex-serviceman, had been facing prolonged issues due to an error in her Pension Payment Order (PPO), which recorded her date of birth as 10/10/2001 instead of the correct 10/10/1982. Although the SPARSH system reflected the correct date, the discrepancy in the PPO hindered her ability to access essential services like the grocery card. After over two years of follow-ups without resolution, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Upon verification, authorities corrected the date of birth and issued a revised PPO, effectively resolving the long-pending matter.

title: Performance Bank Guarantee Disbursed After Year-Long Delay
body: After supplying material under a government purchase order, a company awaited the release of its Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) of ₹27,365 despite the completion of the stipulated period. Repeated follow-ups via email and phone calls to the concerned factory yielded no result for over a year. Seeking resolution, the company filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following the complaint, the matter was reviewed at the factory level, and the PBG linked to the contract was disbursed within a month, bringing the issue to a close.

title: Enhanced Family Pension Arrears Credited After Grievance Escalation
body: A widow receiving family pension was eligible for an enhanced rate until 26 April 2024, but discovered she had only been paid up to 26 April 2022. Despite the entitlement, the arrears remained unpaid for two years. In pursuit of a resolution, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following verification by the concerned authorities, arrears amounting to ₹3,48,585 for the period from 27 April 2022 to 26 April 2024 were successfully credited to her bank account, bringing closure to the matter.

title: OROP-2 Arrears Credited After Departmental Review
body: A retired serviceman faced delays in receiving his OROP-2 arrears despite being eligible. With no progress despite previous attempts, he lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. In response, the Department of Ex-Servicemen Welfare updated the necessary records and conducted a thorough review of the case. Following this intervention by the concerned authorities, the arrears amounting to ₹1,89,786 were successfully processed and credited to his bank account. The grievance was resolved to the satisfaction of the pensioner, with confirmation of the fund transfer communicated thereafter.

title: Arrears Credited Within 8 Days After Grievance Filing
body: A retired army personnel had been awaiting the payment of his arrears amounting to ₹1,03,412 for over two months without any response. Seeking redressal, he filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. The platform enabled swift action by the concerned authorities, and the pending arrears were processed and credited to his account within just 8 days. The prompt resolution brought timely financial relief and successfully closed the grievance.

title: Gratuity Payment Released After CPGRAMS Intervention
body: The widow of a retired Subedar faced hardship after her husband's demise, as the gratuity amount of over ₹10 lakh remained unpaid. Although the bank initiated her family pension and lifetime arrears, they declined to release gratuity, citing that the pension had not commenced before his passing. Needing urgent financial support for her daughter’s marriage, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following the intervention by the concerned authorities, the full gratuity amount was credited to her account within one month, successfully resolving the issue.

title: Disbursement of Family Pension Arrears After CPGRAMS Grievance
body: A family pensioner faced non-receipt of arrears following the death of her husband, an Army retiree. While she was receiving the regular family pension, the arrear amount of ₹73,634 remained unpaid despite multiple follow-ups. Seeking resolution, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. The concerned authorities reviewed the case and after verification and receipt of the required documents from the relevant DPDO, the pending arrears were processed and credited to her bank account, successfully resolving the issue.

title: Failed ATM Deposit Credited After CPGRAMS Grievance
body: A citizen from Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh, reported that ₹1 lakh was not credited to their SBI account due to a timeout error during a transaction at the Malajkhand Cash Deposit Machine. Despite multiple successful deposits on the same day, one transaction failed and remained unresolved. Upon filing a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal, the bank investigated the matter. Following the review by the concerned authorities, the uncredited amount was successfully deposited into the citizen’s account, and the resolution was also communicated via phone call.

title: Loan Limit Activation Issue on Investment Platform Resolved After CPGRAMS Grievance
body: A citizen from Balasore, Odisha, faced an issue where a Loan Against Mutual Funds (LAMF) approved by DSP Finance did not reflect on a popular investment platform, preventing access to the loan limit. Despite multiple complaints and emails to the platform’s support team, the issue remained unresolved. Seeking redressal, the citizen filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. The matter was escalated to DSP Finance, which clarified that the delay was due to a pending lien marking confirmation that hindered system update. Following coordination between the financier and the platform, the issue was resolved. The citizen was able to submit and receive a withdrawal request of ₹3,64,613, and the grievance was successfully closed.

title: PMSBY Insurance Claim Settled After CPGRAMS Escalation
body: A nominee under the Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) faced delays in receiving the insurance claim amount following the unfortunate demise of her husband in a road accident in August 2024. Although the claim was submitted through the bank in early September, no response was received for several weeks despite multiple follow-ups. Seeking redressal, the nominee filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following intervention, the concerned authorities reviewed the matter and United India Insurance Company (UIIC) credited the entitled amount of ₹2,00,000 to the beneficiary's bank account, successfully resolving the issue.

title: DBT Account Seeding Issue Resolved Through CPGRAMS
body: A beneficiary reported an issue with Aadhaar-linked DBT transactions due to an inactive HDFC Bank account being seeded in the NPCI database since 29/10/2021. The complainant requested de-seeding of the inactive HDFC account and the seeding of an active Canara Bank account to ensure future DBT payments are credited correctly. Upon filing a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal, the matter was resolved within 12 days. The concerned authorities confirmed successful linkage of the Canara Bank account with Aadhaar for DBT purposes, ensuring proper credit of future payments.

title: PMJJBY Claim Settled After CPGRAMS Intervention
body: A beneficiary under the Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) had not received the insured claim amount despite completing all formalities. After repeated follow-ups and confirmation from the bank that the required documents were in order, the nominee filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal seeking resolution. Upon intervention, the concerned authorities reviewed the case and confirmed that the claim had been duly processed. The insured amount of ₹2,00,000 was subsequently credited to the nominee’s account. The beneficiary was duly informed, and the grievance was closed to their satisfaction.

title: Insurance Claim Approved After Grievance During Yatra Season
body: A citizen faced delayed settlement of an insurance claim related to the death of a pony during the Pahalgam Yatra season. Despite having submitted all required documents under the relevant proposal and tag number, the claim had not been settled. As a last resort, they filed a complaint on the CPGRAMS portal. Following the grievance, the concerned authorities confirmed that the claim file had been received and the competent authority approved a settlement of ₹48,000. The amount was scheduled for disbursal within 10 working days, and the grievance was accordingly resolved.

title: Medical Insurance Claim Settled After Delay Beyond IRDAI Timeline
body: A citizen from Ahmedabad faced an inordinate delay in the settlement of a medical insurance claim amounting to ₹2,44,157 for a cardiac stent procedure. Although the claim was submitted to Reliance General Insurance in early March 2024, it was not processed within the 30-day timeline prescribed by IRDAI, resulting in a delay of over 60 days. With no resolution through standard channels, the citizen eventually filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. Following this, the insurance company reviewed the case and settled the full claim amount within 8 days. The grievance was thus resolved to the satisfaction of the complainant.

title: Delayed LIC Claim Settled After CPGRAMS Intervention
body: A citizen from New Delhi faced delay in settlement of a life insurance claim from LIC following the death of his mother. Despite submitting the claim in the last week of April 2024, there was no resolution for an extended period. After exhausting regular channels, they lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. The matter was promptly taken up by the concerned authorities, and the claim amounts for four policies—₹4,51,649, ₹8,46,000, ₹7,01,500, and ₹7,89,000—were released within four days, bringing closure to the case.

title: Ayushman Card Successfully Generated After CPGRAMS Grievance
body: A citizen faced difficulty in generating her Ayushman card as her name was not visible on the Ayushman Bharat portal despite using valid Aadhaar and ration card details. Unable to proceed, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Upon review, authorities confirmed her family’s coverage under Ayushman Bharat and successfully generated her Ayushman card. A digital copy was uploaded, and she was advised to visit any Ayushman kiosk for additional copies if required. The grievance was resolved within three weeks.

title: GeM Payment Released with Interest After CPGRAMS Grievance
body: A vendor reported a pending payment of ₹21,000 under GeM Contract, despite timely delivery of materials and CRAC generation. Despite several reminders to the ordering officer, the payment was not received within the 21-day period mandated by GeM policy. Seeking resolution, the complainant filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following intervention by the concerned authorities, the outstanding amount of ₹21,000 along with applicable interest was credited, successfully resolving the issue.

title: CGHS Card Verification Completed After CPGRAMS Intervention
body: A Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) beneficiary faced delays in the verification of their CGHS card, which was issued in October 2023 but remained unverified for several months. Despite attempts to contact the Chandigarh CGHS headquarters via telephone and email, no response was received. Seeking resolution, the beneficiary filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following intervention by the concerned authorities, the CGHS card was verified within 5 days, successfully resolving the issue.

title: Manufacturing License of Misleading “Insulin Tablets” Cancelled After CPGRAMS Grievance
body: A concerned citizen from the medical community filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal regarding homeopathic “Insulin Tablets” manufactured by a Rajasthan-based company. The complaint highlighted that labelling the product as “Insulin” violated the Drugs and Cosmetics Rules and could mislead patients into replacing prescribed insulin injections with these tablets, potentially risking serious health consequences. Following the grievance, the matter was reviewed by the concerned authorities, and within a month, the manufacturing license for the product was cancelled.

title: Assignment Entry Error Corrected, IGNOU Marksheet Issued Promptly
body: Due to an error in the assignment status, where a subject code was mistakenly entered twice, a citizen experienced delays in receiving the final year marksheet from IGNOU. Despite following up with the Regional Centre and receiving multiple assurances, the issue remained unresolved for over two months, jeopardizing eligibility for Assistant Professor examinations. Seeking timely correction, a grievance was filed on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following the intervention by the concerned authorities, the Student Evaluation Division reviewed the case, corrected the assignment entry, and updated the Grade Card. The revised Grade Card was uploaded to the IGNOU website, resolving the issue within three weeks.

title: Pending NATS Stipend Disbursed After Grievance Escalation
body: A citizen registered under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) had not received the stipend for November and December 2024, and January 2025, despite repeated follow-ups via email. With no response and mounting financial pressure, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS portal to expedite the process. The concerned authorities reviewed the matter and confirmed that the stipend payments for November 2024 and January 2025 had been successfully processed, and the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for December 2024 was also initiated. The grievance was resolved promptly

title: IGNOU Study Material Dispatched After Grievance on CPGRAMS
body: A resident of Siwan district, admitted her daughter to IGNOU. Despite paying for the study material at the time of admission, she did not receive the books. Upon inquiry at a nearby study center, she was advised to visit Delhi for resolution, contradicting the official notification stating that materials would be delivered to her home. Seeking assistance, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. The concerned authority reviewed the matter and confirmed that the study material was dispatched via postal. The complainant has been advised to track the shipment and contact the local post office for further assistance. The grievance was resolved within 11 days.

title: NSC Maturity Amount Credited After Grievance Follow-Up
body: A citizen submitted their National Savings Certificates (NSC) for maturity at the Barsul Unnayani Sub Post Office in August but did not receive the matured amount even after several months. With no update from the postal authorities, the citizen filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal requesting immediate intervention. The matter was taken up by the Department of Posts, and the SSPOs Burdwan Division confirmed that the matured amount of ₹47,950 had been credited to the citizen’s SBI account on 4th December 2023. The grievance was successfully resolved.

title: ATM Card Issued After Resolution of Supply Chain Issue
body: A retired BSNL employee was unable to obtain a new ATM card linked to his pension savings account at the Cuddalore Head Post Office. Although his existing card remained valid until November 2024, he was informed that new cards were unavailable due to a stock shortage. With no assistance forthcoming from the bank, he lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. In response, the Tamil Nadu Postal Circle acknowledged the supply chain disruption and arranged for ATM cards through diversion to assist affected account holders. As confirmed over the phone, a new ATM card was issued to the complainant, and the grievance was resolved within two weeks to his satisfaction.

title: PPF Account Transfer Finalized After Ledger Delay
body: A citizen submitted a request to transfer their Public Provident Fund (PPF) account from the Head Post Office in Sonipat, Haryana to a local Axis Bank branch. Although the initial request was made on 5th September 2024, the transfer was delayed by nearly two months. When documents were eventually sent, a key component—the detailed account statement from the account’s opening in 2003 to 2014—was missing, leaving the transfer process incomplete for over three months and causing significant distress. The citizen filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. In response, the Haryana Postal Circle clarified that while the account had been transferred, the missing ledger had not reached the bank. The Postmaster of Sonipat HO confirmed that the ledger details were subsequently sent, thereby resolving the grievance.

title: Road Laid After Complaint on Poor PMGSY Road Quality
body: A citizen raised concerns about the poor quality of a newly re-laid road under the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana, which had been constructed without tar or bitumen. The metal road posed daily challenges for commuters, especially schoolchildren and two-wheeler riders. Seeking resolution, the citizen filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Within just 16 days, the Additional Collector and Project Director in Thoothukudi reviewed the matter and confirmed that strengthening work on the Kootampuli to Sirupadu stretch had been sanctioned. Bituminous concrete was laid on March 14, 2024, and the road was made safe and motorable.

title: TA/DA Payment Released After Delay in Evaluation Duty Reimbursement
body: A school teacher from Shillong, who served as an examiner for CBSE Class XII under the Guwahati Regional Office, faced delays in receiving his TA/DA reimbursement for evaluation duty. Despite multiple follow-ups, the dues remained unpaid. Seeking redressal, the examiner filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Within a month, the grievance was acknowledged and resolved, and the TA/DA payment was successfully processed.

title: NFSC Fellowship Account Linking Approved After Escalation
body: A Ph.D. scholar at Bidhan Chandra Krishi Viswavidyalaya faced repeated rejections while trying to link his account for the National Fellowship for Scheduled Castes (NFSC) under the UGC NET December session. Despite completing all required steps on the Canara Bank Scholarship Portal, the application was held up due to subject classification issues, causing uncertainty and delay in fellowship disbursement. Seeking resolution, the scholar filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. After review, the concerned authorities approved the account linking based on a formal clarification provided by the university registrar, enabling the scholar to access his NFSC fellowship.

title: Final NOS Award Letter Issued After CPGRAMS Intervention
body: Selected under the National Overseas Scholarship (NOS) 2024 for a Master’s program at the University of Sydney, a student faced uncertainty and delay in receiving her final award letter despite completing all formalities, including income and caste verification. The prolonged wait forced her to consider deferring her university admission. With no timely response from the NOS office, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. The matter was swiftly addressed, and the final award letter was issued within three days, allowing her to proceed with her academic plans without further disruption.

title: NOS Award Letter Issued After CPGRAMS Intervention
body: A student selected for the National Overseas Scholarship (NOS) 2024 to pursue a Master of Commerce (Extension) at an international university faced prolonged delays in receiving the final award letter, despite completing all necessary formalities including income and caste verification. The delay created uncertainty and forced her to defer her university intake. Seeking resolution, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. In response, the concerned authorities promptly reviewed the case and issued the award letter within three days, enabling her to proceed with the admission process.

title: Senior Citizen’s Landline Restored After CPGRAMS Grievance
body: An 88-year-old citizen reported that her landline telephone had stopped working despite all dues being cleared. Unable to visit the telephone exchange in person, she made multiple attempts to resolve the issue by emailing MTNL officials and sharing proof of payment, but received no effective response. Seeking a resolution, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. The matter was reviewed by the concerned authorities, and the landline was restored to working condition, effectively resolving the grievance.

title: Security Deposit Refunded After Broadband Service Grievance
body: A broadband customer faced a delay in receiving the security deposit refund from the service provider, despite confirmed termination of service and router collection. Repeated follow-ups with customer support yielded no satisfactory resolution. Seeking redressal, the complainant filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Upon review, the service provider processed the refund through a payment link. The grievance was successfully resolved within 13 days of filing.

title: Set-Top Box Activation Issue Resolved
body: A consumer who had recently subscribed to a new broadband service reported that her set-top box remained inactive despite payment and repeated follow-ups with the service provider. With no resolution in sight, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following the complaint, the service provider promptly investigated the issue, dispatched an engineer, and resolved the technical problem. The services were successfully activated, and the grievance was resolved within 10 days.

title: Kitchen Chimney Payment Released
body: After delivering a wall-mounted kitchen chimney under a government order, a vendor based in West Delhi faced delays in receiving the payment of ₹17,535, despite the CRAC being generated nearly a month earlier. Multiple reminders to the concerned department yielded no results. Seeking resolution, the vendor filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. The Airports Authority of India reviewed the case and confirmed that the bill was under process with the Finance Department. The pending payment was disbursed within 7–10 working days, and the grievance was successfully resolved.

title: Water Facility Restored at Anganwadi Centre
body: A defunct handpump at an Anganwadi Centre in Munda Tola, had been non-functional for over a year. The lack of an alternate water source caused significant hardship to the children and residents in the area. Unlike neighboring tolas with regular water supply, this locality remained neglected. A grievance was raised on the CPGRAMS Portal regarding this issue. Upon reviewing the case, the concerned authorities repaired the handpump, restoring regular water access to the centre and nearby residents. The issue was resolved within a week.

title: Passport Renewal Expedited through CPGRAMS
body: An Indian citizen working in Saudi Arabia, faced significant delay in passport renewal. The passport application, submitted through VF Services Saudi Ltd, had been pending for four months, causing distress as the applicant was seriously ill and unable to return to India without a valid passport. As a last resort, the citizen turned to CPGRAMS. Following the grievance, the Ministry confirmed receipt of the police verification, and the renewed passport was issued. The matter was resolved within two weeks of filing the grievance.

title: Passport Issued After Prolonged Delay
body: A citizen applied for passport renewal and completed police verification shortly after. However, the passport remained unissued for over three months despite repeated attempts to seek updates via the national helpline, the Passport Seva website, and the regional passport office. Needing to travel abroad urgently, the applicant filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following the intervention, the Chandigarh RPO confirmed that the passport had been dispatched. The grievance was resolved within nine days.

title: Second Loan Disbursed Under PM SVANidhi After Grievance
body: A street vendor benefitting from the PM SVANidhi Yojana faced difficulties when her application for a second loan of ₹20,000 was rejected due to a “DISABLE” status erroneously marked by another bank, despite having successfully repaid her first loan and holding a valid No Objection Certificate. Repeated attempts to resolve the matter locally yielded no result. Turning to the CPGRAMS Portal, she filed a grievance seeking intervention. Following the review, it was confirmed that her second loan had been successfully disbursed by the same bank that had issued her first loan. The issue was fully resolved within just eight days.

title: Settlement of pending Provident Fund claim
body: Smt. Pankhuri Sinha resubmitted her PF withdrawal claim after her initial submission was rejected due to discrepancies in the exit date and a mismatch in her father's name in EPFO records. In her resubmission, the complainant furnished additional documents to reconcile pertaining issues. Consequently, the PF claim amounting to ₹5,30,664/- was settled and shall be credited to her bank account in due course. The grievance was successfully resolved within a month, ensuring the complainant's satisfaction.

title: PF Withdrawal Processed Swiftly After Grievance Escalation
body: Faced with a personal emergency, a citizen urgently submitted a request to withdraw his Provident Fund savings and appealed for expedited processing. Despite the critical nature of his situation, the process saw delays. Seeking resolution, he filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following prompt action by the concerned authorities, it was confirmed that his Form 31 claim had been settled successfully, and an amount of ₹2,14,900 was credited to his account. The grievance was closed with the matter resolved.

title: Maternity Claim Released Promptly After Grievance Escalation
body: Despite submitting all necessary documents in September 2023, a citizen faced prolonged delays in the settlement of her maternity claim from the ESIC branch in Kanpur. Even in a physically vulnerable condition, she was asked to make repeated visits and was met with baseless excuses. Adding to her distress, staff members allegedly demanded money to process her claim. Seeking justice, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following the escalation, her case was promptly reviewed, and the full maternity claim amount of ₹1,54,518 was credited via e-payment within just one month of filing the grievance.

title: Pension Sanctioned After UAN-Related Delay
body: A retired employee from Mehsana, Gujarat, faced prolonged delays in the commencement of his monthly pension under the EPS-1995 scheme due to issues in generating a Universal Account Number (UAN) for his old PF account. Despite submitting Form 10D and all required documents multiple times to the EPFO Ahmedabad office, the matter remained unresolved. After repeated follow-ups, the individual lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following intervention by the EPFO Regional Office, the application was approved, and the PPO was issued. Pension disbursement commenced in the next monthly cycle, bringing financial relief.

title: Pending GeM Payment Disbursed to MSME
body: An MSME firm based in Mumbai reported a delay in receiving ₹4,464 for the supply of two LI UPS units delivered on 15 January 2025 via the Government e-Marketplace (GeM). Despite multiple follow-ups with the buyer, no payment was received, causing financial strain. The enterprise filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. After review by the concerned authorities, the pending payment was successfully disbursed within three weeks, resolving the issue.

title: LPG Subsidy Credited After Aadhaar- NPCI Linkage Issue Resolved
body: A consumer holding an HP Gas LPG connection faced non-receipt of LPG subsidy for several months. The LPG distributor cited an Aadhaar linkage issue with NPCI, while the bank confirmed correct linkage. Seeking clarity and resolution, a grievance was filed on the CPGRAMS Portal. Upon verification by the concerned authorities, the linkage issue was addressed, and the pending subsidy was successfully credited to the registered account.

title: Gas Security Deposit Refunded After Grievance Escalation
body: A family that had requested disconnection of their piped gas connection and submitted all required documents experienced a delay in receiving the security deposit refund. Despite repeated follow-ups, the amount remained unpaid. Seeking redressal, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS Portal. The concerned authorities took action, and the refund amount of ₹7,350 was processed and credited to the beneficiary’s account, successfully resolving the issue.

title: LPG Connection Transferred After Grievance Escalation
body: A citizen sought the transfer of an existing LPG connection held by his late father to his own name. The LPG distributor had initially insisted on surrendering the old connection and applying afresh with a composite cylinder, which would have imposed additional financial strain. The situation was especially difficult as the citizen lives with over 80% disability and his mother is elderly. He filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal requesting a resolution. After review by the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas, the transfer request was approved, and the LPG connection was successfully transferred in his name.

title: Delay in Ujjwala Gas Connection Resolved
body: A resident of Cooch Behar, West Bengal, faced delays in receiving her LPG connection under the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana despite applying through the designated distributor. Seeking resolution, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. In response, the distributor confirmed that the connection was handed over on 6th August 2024. The issue was resolved within a week, and the beneficiary confirmed in writing that she had received the benefits under the scheme.

title: Pending Salary and Allowances Credited After CPGRAMS Grievance
body: A recently retired employee from the Ministry of Railways reported non-payment of his June 2024 salary along with pending Kilometerage Allowance for April–June and Night Duty Allowance for May and June. Despite retirement on 30th June 2024, payments remained pending until mid-July. After filing a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal, the Ministry responded within 16 days, confirming that the salary and allowances—amounting to ₹2,72,747—were processed and credited, successfully resolving the issue.

title: Delayed GeM Payment Successfully Processed
body: A registered firm completed an order through the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) by delivering 5 units of All-in-One PCs. Although the items were received, CRAC was generated, and GeM policy mandates payment within 15 days, the firm did not receive the ₹2,10,972 due. Despite follow-ups via calls, emails, and the GeM portal, no action was taken. Eventually, a grievance was filed on the CPGRAMS Portal. Upon intervention by the concerned authorities, the accounts department processed the payment, resolving the issue within two weeks.

title: Refund Processed for Cancelled Accommodation Booking
body: A citizen had booked accommodation at a night halt dormitory in Ahmedabad through IRCTC. However, upon arrival, the hotel refused to honor the booking due to high demand and advised the citizen to cancel. Seeking redressal, the citizen lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. After review by the concerned authorities, a refund of ₹5,880 was approved. The grievance was subsequently resolved and formally closed.

title: Grievance on Unauthorized Median Opening Near Sriperumbudur Toll Plaza
body: An unauthorized median opening near a toll plaza on NH-48 in Tamil Nadu was causing frequent accidents due to its proximity to the toll collection area. Despite repeated alerts, the issue was left unaddressed, endangering commuters. Upon receiving a grievance through CPGRAMS, the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) took urgent action. Within 11 days, they coordinated with the contractor, who closed the unauthorized opening by installing a hard crash barrier. This corrective step mitigated the safety risk and ensured a safer commute for all travelers in the area.

title: Delay in Release of Completion Certificate and Security Deposit by Rural Development & Panchayat Department, Andaman
body: The citizen faced an issue wherein Satellite Services had completed its contract with the Rural Development & Panchayat Department, Andaman. However, the Completion Certificate had not been issued, and the Performance Security Money was pending release. Seeking resolution, the citizen lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. Upon review, the concerned authorities addressed the matter. The Assistant Accounts Officer, Zilla Parishad, North & Middle Andaman, confirmed that the Performance Security Money had been released and forwarded, and the Completion Certificate had also been issued. The grievance was successfully resolved within 13 days of its submission on the CPGRAMS portal.

title: Rejection of Name Change Request Without Justification by GVMC-II, Visakhapatnam
body: A citizen faced difficulties when an application to change his daughter’s name from Sakshi Pratap Rai to Sakshi Roy was rejected by GVMC-II, Visakhapatnam, without providing any valid reason. Despite seeking guidance on the correct procedure, no clear instructions were communicated. To resolve the issue, a grievance was filed on the CPGRAMS Portal. Upon review, the concerned authorities processed the name change successfully. The grievance was resolved, and the resolution was confirmed by the citizen during a follow-up phone call.

title: Complaint Regarding Contaminated Drinking Water Supply in Krishnalanka Ward 22, Vijayawada
body: A citizen from Krishnalanka Ward 22, Vijayawada, reported that the drinking water supplied through municipal taps was black in color and unsafe for consumption. Seeking immediate action to ensure the provision of safe drinking water, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS portal. In response, the authorities addressed the issue by conducting regular water sample tests during supply hours, routinely opening scour valves on the sublines, laying new pipelines throughout the ward, and sanctioning new household connections to improve water quality.

title: Grievance Regarding Non-Receipt of Driving License Card Despite Long Delay
body: A citizen reported that despite applying for a driving license and paying the required fees, the license card had not been received, and the application had been pending for over two years. Multiple attempts to contact the RTA office did not yield any satisfactory response. Seeking resolution, a grievance was filed on the CPGRAMS portal. The issue was addressed, and the driving license card was printed and posted on March 14, 2024, resolving the grievance within 2 days of its submission.

title: Delay in Disposal of Land Record Applications at Narayanpur Revenue Circle, Lakhimpur
body: A citizen faced prolonged delays in the restoration of a name in the Jamabandi of scheduled land at the Narayanpur Revenue Circle, Lakhimpur district. Despite submitting multiple requests and follow-ups with the local revenue authorities, no action was taken on the pending land record applications, causing unnecessary hardship and uncertainty. Seeking timely redressal, the citizen lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. Upon review of the matter, the concerned authorities took necessary action, and the applicant’s name was duly restored in the land records as requested. The grievance was thus successfully resolved.

title: Delay in Re-issuance of Learner's License
body: A citizen faced prolonged delays in the re-issuance of a learner's license, which was applied for in February 2024. Despite the completion of necessary formalities and the passage of more than four months, the application remained pending without any progress or communication from the concerned authorities. Seeking timely intervention, the citizen lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. Upon review, the authorities promptly acted on the matter, and the learner's license was successfully approved within 3 days of filing the grievance, thereby resolving the issue.

title: Delay in Disbursement of Education Loan Under Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
body: A citizen from Begusarai, Bihar, faced a prolonged delay in the disbursement of the remaining ₹2,00,000 from a sanctioned education loan of ₹4,00,000 under the Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme. Despite submitting all required documents, the pending amount was not released, leading to financial stress and penalties imposed by the educational institute. Multiple attempts to contact customer support yielded no response, and the application remained stagnant for weeks. Seeking resolution, a grievance was filed on the CPGRAMS portal. The matter was subsequently reviewed by the concerned authorities, and with appropriate intervention, the pending loan amount was successfully disbursed, therby resolving the grievance.

title: Correction of Electricity Bill Discrepancy in Darbhanga
body: A resident of Darbhanga encountered persistent discrepancies in his electricity bill and repeatedly approached the electricity department to seek rectification. Despite multiple follow- ups, no action was taken, and the issue remained unresolved, causing undue financial stress and confusion. Frustrated by the inaction and lack of accountability, the citizen filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal, requesting intervention for timely resolution. The concerned authorities reviewed the matter, verified the billing records, and confirmed that an error had occurred. The bill was accordingly corrected, resulting in a revised payable amount of ₹961.53. The grievance was successfully addressed and resolved.

title: Delay in Disbursement Under Minimata Mahtari Jatan Yojana
body: A registered labor beneficiary of the Chhattisgarh Bhawan and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board faced delays in receiving benefits under the Minimata Mahtari Jatan Yojana due to documentation issues. Despite submitting the application, no progress was made in processing the claim. Seeking resolution, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS portal. Upon review, the concerned authorities addressed the issue, verified the documents, and processed the claim. The scheme amount of ₹20,000 was subsequently disbursed to the beneficiary’s State Bank of India account, and the grievance was successfully resolved.

title: Correction of PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi Beneficiary Account Details
body: A beneficiary reported that the PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi funds intended for her were being erroneously deposited into another person’s account. Concerned about the misdirected payments and financial loss, a grievance was filed on the CPGRAMS portal seeking immediate intervention. The concerned authorities promptly reviewed the complaint, conducted a thorough verification of the beneficiary details, and identified the discrepancy. After taking corrective measures, the account details were updated, and the funds were successfully transferred to the rightful account. The grievance was resolved, and the beneficiary expressed satisfaction with the swift action taken.

title: GST Refund Processed After Prolonged Delay
body: An applicant who had applied for a GST refund of ₹1,67,208 did not receive the amount within the stipulated timeline, leading to undue delay and concern. Despite waiting beyond the expected period and receiving no resolution through regular follow-ups, a grievance was filed on the CPGRAMS portal seeking intervention. The matter was subsequently taken up by the concerned authorities, thoroughly reviewed, and necessary action was initiated. As a result, the refund was processed and credited to the applicant’s account. The grievance was successfully resolved and closed to the applicant’s satisfaction.
department: Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs

title: Delay in Disbursement Under Kuverbai Na Mameru Yojana
body: A resident of Surat, Gujarat, experienced an undue delay in receiving the financial assistance of ₹12,000 under the Kuverbai Na Mameru Yojana, a scheme designed to provide monetary support to economically weaker families for their daughters’ marriage. Despite submitting a duly completed application along with the required documentation, there was no update or confirmation of the amount being credited to her bank account. Repeated follow-ups yielded no response, causing stress and uncertainty. Seeking redressal, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal requesting timely intervention. The concerned authorities took prompt cognizance of the matter, reviewed her application, and confirmed that it had been approved. Subsequently, the sanctioned amount was credited to her account, and the grievance was successfully resolved and closed.

title: Relocation of Electricity Power Line Causing Construction Obstruction
body: A resident of Umrai, Vadodara, encountered a major obstacle in carrying out construction work on her property due to the presence of an overhead electricity service line running directly through the site. Despite the fact that the line had been laid without her consent, the local electricity office did not take any action on her request for relocation and instead asked her to bear the cost of ₹5,000–6,000, causing unnecessary financial and procedural hardship. Frustrated by the lack of response, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal seeking intervention. Upon review, the concerned authorities acknowledged the issue and promptly took corrective measures by relocating the service line to a nearby pole. The action allowed the resident to resume construction, and the grievance was successfully resolved and closed.

title: Inconsistent Power Supply in Bhikam Colony, Faridabad, Haryana
body: A resident of Bhikam Colony, Faridabad, Haryana, faced continuous power disruptions due to a fault in the electricity supply, where only one phase was functioning while the other remained inactive. This led to nightly power outages for six consecutive days, severely affecting the routine and comfort of residents in the area. Despite the persistence of the issue, no corrective action was initially taken. Seeking timely intervention, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS portal. In response, the area in-charge Junior Engineer (JE) conducted a site inspection, identified the technical fault, and resolved the issue by replacing the transformer supply cable and repairing the LT fuse. The consumer was informed of the resolution, and the grievance was successfully closed.

title: Non-Payment of Final Settlement by Former Employer
body: A former employee faced non-payment of her final month's salary amounting to ₹40,000 after leaving her previous organization, Veye Pvt. Ltd. Despite multiple follow-ups through emails and phone calls, the employer refused to clear her dues. She also highlighted that several other employees had encountered similar issues. Seeking resolution, she submitted a grievance along with her relieving letter through the CPGRAMS Portal. Following intervention, the matter was taken up by the concerned authorities, and the pending settlement amount was processed, resolving the grievance satisfactorily.

title: Correction of Examination Result at Amar Singh College, Srinagar
body: A student of Amar Singh College, Srinagar, faced a discrepancy in her examination result, which incorrectly showed zero marks despite her successful completion of the exam. She made several efforts to get the error corrected, including reaching out to the Controller of Examinations and the Examination Coordinator, submitting her attendance sheet, and receiving repeated assurances of resolution. However, despite multiple follow-ups, the issue remained unresolved, causing significant academic distress. Seeking redressal, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. The concerned authorities reviewed the matter, verified her records, and subsequently declared the corrected result, thereby resolving the grievance.

title: Delay in Payment of Post-Matric Scholarship by Government of Jharkhand
body: A student faced a delay in receiving her post-matric scholarship from the Government of Jharkhand. Although she was initially informed that the amount would be credited within a week, more than a month passed without the funds being transferred to her account. Frustrated by the inaction, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal seeking resolution. Following the intervention of the concerned authorities, the matter was reviewed and the pending scholarship amount of ₹6,300 was credited to her account within 10 days of filing the grievance, successfully resolving the issue.

title: Urgent Repair of Handpumps in Janardanpur Village, Jharkhand
body: In Janardanpur village, Jharkhand, two handpumps near the Lakshmi Temple remained dysfunctional for several months, causing severe hardship during an ongoing water crisis intensified by the summer heat. Despite repeated appeals by villagers to the Gram Panchayat head and the local Jal Sahiya, no action was taken to address the issue. To seek resolution, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS portal requesting immediate repair of the handpumps. In response, the concerned authorities reviewed the matter and confirmed through an official report that both handpumps were repaired within 8 days of the grievance being filed, providing significant relief to the village residents.

title: Restoration of Disrupted Tap Water Supply
body: A resident experienced a week-long disruption in tap water supply, severely affecting daily household activities and access to clean drinking water. Despite local attempts, the issue remained unresolved, causing inconvenience to the household. Seeking timely intervention, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS portal. Upon receiving the complaint, the concerned authorities acted promptly, investigated the disruption, and carried out the necessary repairs. As per the official report, the tap water supply was successfully restored, ensuring regular and uninterrupted access to clean water. The grievance was resolved within 9 days of submission.

title: Resolution of Pay Fixation Error and Arrears Disbursement Under 7th Pay Commission
body: An employee raised a grievance regarding incorrect pay fixation and long-pending arrears under the 7th Pay Commission, which had not been addressed despite repeated attempts through departmental channels. The delay in rectifying the pay structure and disbursing the entitled arrears caused significant financial uncertainty. Seeking redressal, the employee lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. In response, the concerned authorities thoroughly reviewed the case, verified the calculations, and took corrective action. As a result, the first installment of ₹6,08,848 was processed, followed by a second installment of ₹1,95,209. A total amount of ₹8,04,057 was disbursed, and it was confirmed that no arrears remain pending. The grievance was fully resolved to the satisfaction of the complainant.

title: Firm’s Bank Account Frozen Without Prior Notice Due to Unrelated Tax Demand
body: A firm’s HDFC Bank account was frozen without any prior notice by the authorities due to a tax demand related to a separate firm owned by the proprietor’s father. An amount of ₹23,817 was recovered without issuing the required Form 36 or informing the concerned proprietor, which was in violation of provisions under the Madhya Pradesh VAT rules. Facing financial inconvenience and procedural irregularity, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS portal seeking corrective action. Upon intervention, the matter was taken up with the concerned HDFC Bank branch in Seoni, which further communicated with the lead bank. Following discussions and review, the issue was resolved, the account was unfrozen, and the complainant confirmed satisfaction. The grievance was successfully closed.

title: Amount Deducted but Not Reflected in MHADA Account After Online Payment
body: A resident made an online payment of ₹2,545 through the e-billing portal using UPI towards maintenance charges. Although the amount was successfully deducted from her bank account, it did not reflect in her MHADA account, leading to confusion and concern about the transaction status. Despite waiting for an update, the issue remained unresolved. Seeking clarification and corrective action, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS portal. Following the complaint, the Property Manager at the Sion office took up the matter and contacted the concerned department’s computer engineer to investigate the discrepancy. After verification, the payment was successfully updated in the system, and the grievance was resolved to the satisfaction of the complainant.

title: Mosquito Control Measures Implemented
body: A severe mosquito infestation in Krishna Nagar Housing Society, Pune, caused by open drains and stagnant water sources, was leading to serious inconvenience and potential health risks for residents. The citizen sought immediate intervention, requesting fogging and drainage clean- up. A grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS Portal to escalate the matter. In response, the concerned authorities inspected the site and undertook the necessary vector control measures. The open drains were cleaned, and fogging operations were conducted to eliminate breeding grounds. The grievance was accordingly resolved.

title: Wrong Challan Issued
body: A citizen received an incorrect traffic challan for not wearing a seatbelt on the Pune Expressway, issued against his vehicle number. Upon examining the challan, it was evident that the vehicle in question was a silver Maruti Ertiga, whereas the citizen owned a grey Maruti Baleno. Furthermore, he had not travelled on the Pune Expressway during the specified time period and even cited toll records to support his claim. Despite reaching out to the Central VAHAN helpline, no corrective action was taken initially. To escalate the matter, he filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following the complaint, the concerned authorities reviewed the issue, verified the discrepancy, and took corrective steps by updating the challan with the correct vehicle number. The grievance was thus resolved to the citizen’s satisfaction.

title: GST Refund Processing Delay
body: A citizen faced nearly two years of delay in receiving his GST refund despite fulfilling all formalities. His application, eligible under Section 54(7) of the CGST Act, remained unprocessed due to "Pending Bank Account Validation," causing financial strain. He had submitted all required documents as per Rule 8G, with no deficiencies flagged. After repeated attempts failed, he filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following this, the authorities reviewed the matter and processed the refund. A sanction order of ₹1,02,400 was issued towards the excess balance in the electronic cash ledger, and a copy was shared for reference, resolving the grievance.
department: Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs

title: Delay in Refund of Cash Balance under GST
body: A citizen submitted a refund application for a cash balance of ₹40,732 under GST but did not receive the amount despite waiting for several months and fulfilling all necessary formalities. Facing prolonged delay and financial inconvenience, the citizen filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal requesting that the refund order be issued and the amount credited. Upon receiving the grievance, the GST authorities reviewed the case, conducted a site visit, and ensured compliance with all required procedures. As a result, the refund of ₹40,732 was processed and credited to the citizen’s account, resolving the matter.
department: Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs

title: Hazardous Electric Wire Issue Resolved
body: A citizen faced a serious electrical safety hazard near his residence, where a live service wire was lying dangerously on the ground due to the absence of a proper electric pole. Despite repeated complaints and follow-ups with the local electricity distribution company, no action was taken for over two months. In the meantime, to prevent accidents, the citizen had to support the wire with a bamboo pole—posing a grave risk to public safety. Frustrated with the inaction, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following the escalation, the concerned electricity department took prompt corrective measures and installed a new electric pole at the location to eliminate the hazard. The issue was fully resolved, and photographic evidence of the completed work was shared to confirm the action taken.

title: Request for Financial Assistance for Higher Education
body: A student from Odisha, who had secured 87% in his Higher Secondary Examination and gained admission to BJB Autonomous College for Political Science (Honors), faced financial hardship due to his father's critical illness. Struggling to afford essential expenses such as hostel fees, food, and study materials, he sought financial assistance to continue his education. To address this challenge, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS Portal highlighting his situation. Upon review, the matter was taken up by the concerned district administration, and a financial grant of ₹5,000 was sanctioned from the District Red Cross Fund, providing much-needed support for his academic journey.

title: Grievance Regarding Refund for Returned Items from a Store
body: A citizen’s parents purchased items worth ₹2,900 from a local store for a family function, which was later cancelled due to a bereavement. When they attempted to return the items, the store initially agreed to refund ₹2,000 but kept delaying the payment despite multiple visits and phone calls. Even after warnings about possible police intervention, the refund was not issued. Frustrated by the continued evasion, the citizen lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following escalation and persistent follow-up by the police department, the shop owner finally refunded the ₹2,000. The grievance was successfully resolved, and the citizen expressed appreciation for the support extended by CPGRAMS and the Puducherry Police Department

title: Incorrect EB Meter Reading and Overbilling
body: A citizen received an abnormally high electricity bill amounting to ₹1,35,512, which was far above the usual monthly billing of around ₹3,000. The inflated charge was caused by an incorrect meter reading. At the time, the citizen was undergoing medical treatment and was unable to visit the Electricity Board office in person to address the issue. Concerned about the overbilling, he lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Promptly after the complaint was raised, the Electricity Board reviewed the case, rectified the erroneous reading, and issued a revised bill reflecting the correct amount. The issue was resolved within 12 days, ensuring relief to the complainant.

title: Delay in Driver’s License Endorsement Approva
body: A citizen experienced an undue delay in obtaining approval for an additional endorsement on his Driver’s License, despite having successfully cleared the required driving skill test. Even after waiting for more than a month, there was no update or progress on the application, causing concern and inconvenience. To seek redressal, he lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Following the escalation, the concerned authorities reviewed the matter, processed the pending request, and approved the application. The grievance was accordingly resolved to the satisfaction of the complainant.

title: Discrepancy in Ayushman Bharat Card
body: A citizen from Ludhiana, Punjab, encountered a technical discrepancy while applying for his Ayushman Bharat card, wherein his wife’s Aadhaar number was incorrectly linked to his farmer ID. This error prevented him from completing the KYC verification process and availing the health scheme benefits. Faced with this roadblock, he lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal, seeking timely correction. Upon escalation, the concerned authorities reviewed and resolved the issue by rectifying the Aadhaar linkage in the system. The citizen was subsequently advised to generate his e-card through the Ayushman App or beneficiary portal. The grievance was successfully resolved.

title: Blocked Drain Cleared After Complaint Resolution
body: A resident of Mahu Kala, Gangapur City, Rajasthan, faced persistent inconvenience due to the blockage of a drainage line by nearby individuals. This led to the accumulation of wastewater on the road, creating unsanitary conditions for both local residents and passersby. The stagnant water emitted a foul smell and became a breeding ground for mosquitoes and flies, raising serious health concerns. To address the issue, the citizen lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. Following the complaint, the Gram Vikas Adhikari investigated the matter and ensured that the blocked drainage was thoroughly cleared. The problem was resolved, restoring sanitation and preventing further public health risks.

title: Non-receipt of PM-KISAN Instalment
body: A citizen reported non-receipt of the 16th and 17th instalments under the PM-Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana, despite having completed all the required formalities, including land record verification, Aadhaar-bank account seeding, and e-KYC. Concerned about the delay in receiving the Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), he filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal requesting immediate disbursal of the pending instalments. Upon examination of the records, the concerned authorities from the Government of Rajasthan clarified that all payments had already been processed successfully, and no instalments were pending as per their official records. The grievance was accordingly closed.

title: Delay in PM Fasal Bima Yojana Claim Settlement
body: A farmer from Sillakudi (South) village, Perambalur district, faced delays in receiving his crop insurance claim under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) for the 2023–24 season. Despite completing the application process and following up with customer care, his claim remained unresolved for a considerable period. Seeking redressal, he lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal requesting approval and disbursal of the claim amount. Upon review by the concerned authorities, it was confirmed that the crop insurance claim amounting to ₹37,712 had been successfully credited to his Canara Bank account, thereby resolving the grievance.

title: Grievance Regarding Partial Refund and Delay in Certificate Return from Sri Ramakrishna Institute of Technology
body: A student had taken admission to Sri Ramakrishna Institute of Technology in Coimbatore but later withdrew due to the long travel distance from home. Despite having paid ₹1,05,000 during admission, only ₹86,000 was refunded, and there was an inordinate delay in returning the original certificates. Facing difficulty in obtaining both the balance refund and documents, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS portal. Following the intervention of concerned authorities, the matter was resolved, and the institute returned the original certificates and refunded the remaining amount, ensuring full redressal of the grievance.

title: Dysfunctional Park Lights Resulting in Unsafe Premises
body: A citizen had been raising concerns with the local authorities in Chandigarh regarding non- functional park lights near his residence. The persistent darkness in the park led to an unsafe environment, drawing antisocial elements and creating serious risks for families and children who frequented the area. Despite multiple complaints through local channels, the issue remained unresolved. Seeking a permanent solution, the citizen lodged a grievance on the CPGRAMS portal. After escalation through the platform, the concerned authorities promptly addressed the matter and carried out the necessary repairs. The park lights were restored, ensuring the safety and well-being of residents in the locality.

title: Pending Widow Pension Payment
body: A widow from Chandauli district, Uttar Pradesh, who was listed in the pension beneficiary list for the financial year, did not receive the entitled widow pension amount in her bank account. Concerned about the delay, she filed a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal requesting the immediate disbursal of her pension. The matter was taken up by the concerned authorities, and the District Probation Officer of Chandauli, Women Welfare Department, examined the issue. It was confirmed that ₹3,000 had been successfully transferred to her bank account and the same was also communicated to her via a phone call. The grievance was resolved satisfactorily, ensuring timely financial support to the beneficiary.

title: Water Supply Restored After Grievance Escalation
body: A resident of village Nagad in Tehsil Chaukhutiya, District Almora, experienced a prolonged disruption in the drinking water supply from Jal Sansthan Ranikhet Chaukhutiya. Despite repeated complaints and personal visits to the local department officials, no action was taken to resolve the issue. Seeking redressal, a grievance was lodged on the CPGRAMS portal. The matter was reviewed by the concerned authorities, leading to the restoration of the water supply. As confirmed by the complainant through the portal, the water supply is now functioning smoothly, and the grievance was subsequently closed.

title: Delay in Reinstallation of Electricity Meter After Payment
body: A consumer faced prolonged delays in the reinstallation of his electricity meter, even after clearing the pending dues amounting to ₹46,530. His connection had been disconnected earlier due to rental rate issues, and despite multiple visits and follow-ups with the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum of UPCL Kumaon Zone in Haldwani, no action was taken. The complainant also experienced uncooperative behaviour from staff, adding to his distress. Frustrated by the lack of resolution, he submitted a grievance on the CPGRAMS Portal. Acting promptly on the grievance, the electricity meter was reinstalled within two days, and the sealing certificate was also issued, bringing the matter to a successful conclusion
